newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian 88 to bid for Morrison.
newsitem.headline: Canadian 88 to bid for Morrison.

text.p: Canadian 88 Energy Corp said on Monday it plans to make a takeover offer for Morrison Petroleums Ltd.
Canadian 88 said it plans to offer C$10 cash, up to C$140 million, or 1.5 Canadian 88 common shares for each common share of Morrison. Morrison had 65.2 million shares outstanding at December 31.
The offer is conditional upon the poison pill announced by Morrison on January 10 being rescinded or otherwise rendered ineffective as regards Canadian 88's offer, Canadian 88 said.
The bid is also conditional upon no less than 50.1 percent of the Morrison common shares being tendered and not withdrawn under the bid.
The company said about eight percent of the shares have been committed to the offer by a company acting together with Canadian 88.
Canadian 88 added that the share price offered is at a 19 percent premium to Morrison's stock price on Friday.
The company cited the operating synergies between the two firms and said the offer will have a positive impact on Canadian 88's per share cash flow.

"The combined company will have a debt to cash flow ratio which will not exceed 1.2:1 and a market capitalization of C$1.2 billion," Canadian 88 president and chief executive Greg Noval said in a statement.
The offer, which is subject to approval by the appropriate authorities, will be open for 21 days from the date of mailing.
Canadian 88 has hired Gordon Capital Corp and Midland Walwyn Capital Inc as its financial advisers for this transaction.
